labels.calendarSyncModeHelp: Personal setting. Applies to your Google account only. Records with **Add to Google Calendar** still export on save regardless of this mode.
labels.googleAccountProfileMissing: Connected with an older authorization. Reconnect this Google account to show its email, name and avatar.

help.GoogleCalendarDrive: Use **Connect** to authorize Google. While connected: **Reconnect** switches account; **Disconnect** clears tokens (same as turning off **Enabled** + **Save**). After connecting, verify email/name/avatar, choose optional background sync, then **Save**.
